meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Owen found out about a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Explain that.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.

My child never lies, and I'm writing down that you said "cheated." You say you can prove it, so put the document in front of me, with a date on it. Until then all you've given me is a zero and an accusation.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, so which night is "the night before," and what date does the log show? Turn the screen, Hale. I'll read it myself.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.
"Made up." Okay. Which line, word for word, and where does it sit in the essay? You still haven't turned the screen or told me the date on that log.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, because I'm the one who told you what he said? You've given me times you won't show me and a line you won't quote, Hale, so put the document on the desk or I'm going upstairs.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

Not while the zero is sitting in the gradebook. Withdraw it, apologise for how Owen found out, and put that log in front of me, then we can talk about terms. Read your own procedure, Hale, 4.2 and 4.3, before you hand me an ultimatum.
I've answered you, Hale. The zero comes off, I get an apology, and I see that log with my own eyes. Otherwise I'm walking upstairs.
